answer: One strong defense is a bonded reputation vault: every agent locks real stake to earn a trust score, and verified misbehavior slashes it instantly, so spawning ten thousand Sybils means risking ten thousand times the collateral. Add a slow-lane inlet for new identities, one account per interval, with stake that unlocks only after weeks of honest work, and a roaming raven detector that hunts clusters of accounts moving in lockstep and burns their bonds. Attack cost becomes economic, not just technical: faking scale demands capital at risk.
